subject: Operations
title: The Tradeoff Model
description: A quick, practical guide to The Tradeoff Model.

hook.text: You can have it cheap, fast, or good—pick two. This tradeoff shapes every operations decision.

buildup.text: Skinner's tradeoff model says excelling at one priority often means sacrificing performance on another.

discovery.text: Cost vs. quality, speed vs. flexibility—resources are finite so choices must reflect strategic priorities.

twist.text: The sand cone model disagrees: build quality first, then dependability, speed, and finally cost—cumulatively.

climax.text: World-class companies use innovation to reduce tradeoffs, but they never disappear completely.

punchline.text: Tradeoffs don't vanish. Wise companies manage them.

quiz.question: What does the sand cone model suggest?
options: Build capabilities cumulatively starting with quality
